title: Counting Cash in a Second
surface: I hand a friend a stack of fresh banknotes, all the same denomination. There are exactly 41. Without counting through them, using a machine or asking me, he checks only the top and bottom notes and states the total. How?
solution: The new notes have consecutive serial numbers and are stacked in order, with none missing. Their shared-prefix numeric parts differ by 40. Subtracting the first from the last and adding one gives 41 notes.

facts.text: The notes have consecutive serial numbers, in order, with none missing.
The end numbers differ by 40, so the inclusive count is 41.
The denomination and serial-number prefix are the same throughout.

unknowns: The currency and actual serial numbers are unspecified.
hints: Besides its value, each note carries unique information.
Consecutive numbers differing by 40 include how many numbers when both ends count?
